guidance: Project, bachelor’s thesis, master’s dissertation or formal evidence synthesis.
Select one of the eight routes.
Use only when it has a distinct evidence role.
Name the artefact, participant, case, study, run, record or other unit.
Name the evidence that must exist before the principal claim can be made.
Name the baseline, reference case, alternative account or protocol basis.
State the main limit that must remain visible.
Write the attractive but unsupported claim that must not be made.
Name the gate currently being prepared.
Name the next record that will reduce the most consequential uncertainty.
